chunks: From him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn 'Ali ibn Faddal, from 'Amr ibn Sa'id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from 'Ammar al-Sabati, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, concerning

Regarding a man who forgets one sajdah, then remembers it after he has stood up and performed ruku', he said: He continues in his salat and does not perform the sajdah until he gives salam. Then when he gives salam, he performs a sajdah like the one he missed. I said: And if he does not remember except after that? He said: He makes up what he missed when he remembers it.

key_terms.سَلَّمَ: he completed the prayer with salam
key_terms.مَا فَاتَهُ: what he missed from the prayer
key_terms.يَقْضِي: he makes up or performs later what was missed
key_terms.يَمْضِي: he continues and proceeds with the prayer
key_terms.يُسَلِّمَ: he gives the concluding salam of the prayer

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he forgets one sajdah in salat and remembers after ruku'?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about one who forgets a single sajdah in salat and only remembers after standing and performing ruku'. He should continue the prayer, then perform the missed sajdah after salam; if he remembers later than that, he should make up what he missed when he remembers.
